semiconductor_relevance: High — Enplas Semiconductor Peripheral Corporation specializes in test and burn-in sockets, which are critical for the evaluation and reliability of semiconductor devices.
summary: Enplas Semiconductor Peripheral Corporation designs and manufactures high-performance test and burn-in sockets tailored for high heat generation and multi-pin configurations. Their advanced microfabrication technology and specialized materials ensure reliable contact and temperature control, supporting the testing of next-generation semiconductor packages.
capabilities: High-performance test sockets for high heat generation
Burn-in sockets with durability-enhancing plating technology
Temperature-controlled sockets with ceramic heaters and sensors

regional_presence.Japan: The company is based in Japan and serves major semiconductor clients including Intel and Samsung.
